method: Seven game-calendar days (07:00 Day 1 through 23:59 Day 7); actual current engine advanceTown with authored offlineResult, normal action validation and synthetic player positioning. No clock skipping or NPC teleportation; player travel time is intentionally excluded. A core experiment, not a browser/UI/human playtest. All fresh towns keep their original 90 coins. Balances are never manually adjusted.

Trace Resident completed the agreed reference check and earned 2. Payment is for the recorded work; the independent lookup has not yet established usefulness.
Arwyn completed the agreed source check and earned 2. Payment is for the recorded work; the independent lookup has not yet established usefulness.
Trace Resident submitted index revision 1: 3 verified locations; other entries remain provisional or unresolved. Historical date confidence is separate.
Northern physically reached the library and searched the submitted Cedar reference for room-access: found in Cedar. Northern earned 2 for his actual search and report.
Trace Resident chose a small park reading with Northern and Sub. Their invitation is accepted around existing work; attendance and refreshments remain voluntary.
Trace Resident bought a shared bread tray for 2. The money went to the grocery till; old personal tabs are unchanged.
Trace Resident bought a shared tea tray for 2. The money went to the cafe till; old personal tabs are unchanged.

Trace Resident joined Northern's first reading in the park. The town has a shared moment to remember, not just a filed record. Northern rests his page on the park bench. ‘I thought I needed a proper room before I could begin.’ Northern reads: ‘There was a town where nobody asked what you had finished. They asked what you had begun.’ His hands stop shaking halfway through. Sub: ‘Two listeners count. A first page does not need a grand opening.’ They pass round Baba's bread tray and Kevin's tea tray. Your coins have become something shared.
Project closed. Earned fees stay paid; all remaining money returned equally to the contributing tills. The index remains common.
